welcome.title: OpenCode Mobile
welcome.subtitle: Connect to the OpenCode server you already run.
welcome.body: OpenCode Mobile is a client for an existing OpenCode server. You point it at your server, pick a workspace, and start coding. The server keeps running the models and the work.

server.title: Connect to your server
server.description: Enter the URL of your OpenCode server. Credentials stay on this device.

workspace.title: Choose a workspace
workspace.description: Pick the project folder the server should work in. You can change it later.

optional.title: Tune it later
optional.description: Preferences and permissions are optional and can be changed any time in Settings.

connect.title: Connect to OpenCode
connect.subtitle: Point OpenCode Mobile at your running server. Username and password are optional.
connect.failed: Could not connect to the server.
connect.hint: Example: http://192.168.1.10:4096. If you open a web UI at this address, use its API base URL instead, usually ending in /api.
connect.pairHint: Cloud Linkでデバイスをペアリングするか、下にサーバーURLを入力してください。

workspace.title: Choose a workspace
workspace.subtitle: These are the projects your server knows about. Pick one to start in.
workspace.empty: This server did not report any projects. Add a directory on the server to get started.

preferences.title: Basic preferences
preferences.subtitle: Optional. Everything here can be changed later in Settings.
preferences.modelHint: Leave this on the server default if you are not sure.

provider.title: No AI provider configured
provider.body: Your OpenCode server has no AI provider configured yet. You can continue and set one up later from Settings › AI & providers.

permissions.title: Permissions
permissions.subtitle: Optional. OpenCode Mobile only asks when you choose to enable something.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.body: Allow OpenCode Mobile to notify you when a task finishes while the app is in the background.
notifications.unsupported: Notifications are not available on this platform.

voice.title: Voice input
voice.body: Microphone access lets you dictate prompts instead of typing them.
voice.unsupported: Voice input is not available on this device.
voice.deniedHint: You can still turn voice input on later from Settings › Voice & responses.

ready.title: You're ready
ready.subtitle: Review your setup and start coding.
ready.footnote: You can change any of this later in Settings.

settingsAssistant.title: Setup assistant
settingsAssistant.summary: Review connection, workspace, preferences, and permissions
